calls.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: Critter Lab art-direction concept board, exactly 1024 x 1536 pixels, 2:3 portrait.
Purpose: one of three comparable art-direction concepts for owner review; not a complete native game interface. Create one polished original raster board, mostly illustration, with sparse readable typesetting. Do not imitate the existing pixel-art draft.
Composition: 48-pixel minimum safe margins; small title area, then three flowing story regions: field discovery upper 30 percent, research finding middle 30 percent, saved pet and family lower 36 percent. Maintain generous space and clear correspondence between text and subject, no ornamental panel grid. Render the quoted English text correctly.

SHARED STORY AND SEMANTIC CONTRACT:
Upper field discovery: depict a movable fallen branch blocking a reachable path leading to a visible closed neutral cache. Cache remains closed. The path, blocking branch and closed cache must be visually unmistakable. Caption exactly "Move the branch. Then choose Take." Moving merely opens access; collection is a separate action. Do not reveal the sample's traits, a creature in the cache, or a reward already in inventory.
Middle research: title exactly "Sample A — coat finding". Heritage and coat are known. Show exactly two equal-size internally cropped dark coat texture specimens, with no body silhouette or body parts. The plain coat crop must be uniform dark coat without any pale marks, cream belly, highlights suggesting hidden marks, eyes, limbs, crown or body boundaries. The marked crop must use the same dark ground with unmistakable crisp cream islands and bands. Label the two crops exactly "Plain · pale carried" and "Pale markings · expressed". Place a separate text node exactly "Movement unknown" and footer exactly "Finding saved". Convey a supported inherited relationship; do not suggest mutation, direct selection into a desired trait or completed knowledge of movement.
Lower family: heading exactly "After full research — family possibility". Show exactly three individuals with legible branching relationship connectors whose meaning is a possibility, never a completed birth. Largest emotional anchor is saved founder labeled "Pip · PIP-001": friendly rounded quadruped, broad dark charcoal body, cream belly, very large orange eyes with cream eye rings, short limbs, green leaflike crown. Pip has plain dark coat with NO pale coat markings outside cream belly and cream eye rings. Label below Pip exactly "Plain · carries pale". Second parent labeled "Hypothetical partner": same broad quadruped body plan, plain dark coat, cream belly and cream eye rings, short limbs, NO crown and NO pale coat markings elsewhere; below it exactly "Plain · carries pale". Third individual labeled "Possible child": same broad body plan, smaller crownless child, dark coat with very clear cream coat islands/bands in addition to cream eye rings; below it exactly "Pale markings". Pip must be unmistakably the founder and largest emotional subject, child must have no crown. Family portrait is permitted only under the explicitly full-research heading.

Constraints: no extra characters or individuals, no probabilities, care meters, resource inventories, birth controls, simulated device controls, buttons, touchscreen hints, device mockups, physical laboratory room, dashboard, panel grid, watermark or additional invented text. All text labels must associate clearly with their intended subjects.
Reference identity: design/v1-pip/pip-carried.png supplies Pip's identity traits only, not rendering style, layout, palette or a pixel-art restriction.

Board title (verbatim): "A — Living field folio"
STYLE AND COMPOSITION:
Create a warm contemporary naturalist game folio. Hand-drawn ink contours, dry gouache shapes, subtle pencil construction and warm ivory negative space; elegant, curious, alive. Avoid antique parchment, decorative handwriting and beige uniformity. Field: an asymmetrical landscape vignette opens into the page; blocked route and cache are obvious. Research: two closely observed, softly edged internal coat specimens sit beside a restrained fine-line relationship drawing; annotation follows the subjects. Family: Pip receives an intimate, expressive three-quarter portrait, with partner and possible child arranged in a legible small branching composition. Pine green, slate, apricot and cream organize atmosphere; knowledge remains textual. Selective texture never competes with creature markings. No pixel rendering or thick panel borders.

Board title (verbatim): "B — Miniature lives"
STYLE AND COMPOSITION:
Create a tactile miniature-world game aesthetic: softly sculpted ceramic/resin forms, rounded modeled volumes, crisp silhouette, restrained surface grain, directional studio lighting and generous calm backgrounds. Field: a low-angle miniature landscape shows the cache beyond the movable blocking branch. Research: two flat, internally cropped material samples float at equal scale in clean space, connected by precise restrained graphic annotation; they are coat references, not body parts or apparatus. Family: three sculptural characters form a triangular composition, Pip forward and warmly lit, partner and possible child separated by fine explanatory connectors. Cream, dusty teal and burnt coral environment; preserve dark coat and pale marks. Avoid gloss overload, plasticky interface widgets and a physical lab room.

Board title (verbatim): "C — Graphic ecology"
STYLE AND COMPOSITION:
Create a striking contemporary cut-paper/linocut game language. Flat interlocking silhouette masses, confident irregular contours, sparse carved texture and bold editorial typography; high contrast, playful intelligence. Field: overhead-oblique landscape assembled from a few large rhythmic shapes, negative-space path reaching the branch before the cache. Research: two enormous equal-scale coat windows anchor a branching graphic relationship; solid known connectors versus a broken unknown connector, always with labels. Family: Pip, partner and possible child form an expressive emblem-like branching composition with independent readable silhouettes. Deep ink, warm white, vermilion and leaf green; coat markings stay visually distinct from print texture. No faux depth, gradients, pixel art or framed dashboard.
